notes: Answers three copy gaps from today's loremaster gate on the day-is-the-run integration (pipeline/gates/loremaster-day-is-the-run-2026-08-19.md), not the UI-only brief currently sitting in pipeline/BRIEF.md. Two firstRead items close the diagBench REVISE/ruling-21 gap the gate flagged: FirstRead currently keys REPAIR_STATION_COPY by station, so diagBench2 and diagBench3 both replay diagBench1's sealed-envelope text. These two items are the new per-repair text; the Orchestrator's engine-side change (keying firstRead by RepairId instead of station for multi-stage stations, per the gate's own recommendation) is a prerequisite for landing them and is out of narrative-director's lane. The third item fulfills the tutorial-agent's open copy order at pipeline/copy/orders/strain-carryover-notice.json, mirrored here and written back to that order file with status done.

items.replaces: REPAIR_STATION_COPY.diagBench.firstRead (currently reused verbatim for diagBench2, written for diagBench1's sealed envelope)
lines: The deeper pass turns up more than clean readouts. It shakes a sector loose from the bench's own cache, buried under years of noise.
Damaged, but not gone. It queues itself before you can even reach for it.
items.notes: Payload is SECTOR_SCENES[2] (the bench-light-at-night scene), which plays immediately after this vignette and already carries its own RECOVERED SECTOR 2 OF 9 / PLAYBACK FOLLOWS system beat, so this text does not repeat that announcement. Deliberately does not say Filed to DAD.VOL. nothing is filed to DAD.VOL here; that claim belongs only to diagBench1's actual sealed envelope. Does not restate the envelope beat. Diegetic bench voice, no names.

items.replaces: REPAIR_STATION_COPY.diagBench.firstRead (currently reused verbatim for diagBench3, which per ruling 21 leaves the 480 CR repair with no beat of Dad at all)
lines: Behind the last panel sits a reference rig he built from scratch, no manufacturer stamp on it anywhere.
Every calibration point is filed by hand, checked twice, logged in his own writing on a card taped to the housing.
PATIENT WORK READS HONEST, the card says, underlined once. Nothing else on it.
items.notes: This vignette is diagBench3's sole artifact channel under ruling 21 (channel C, no sector left to assign and no DAD.VOL entry), so it has to carry a genuine beat of Dad on its own. Uses the calibration-rig and handwriting material and echoes the patience theme from SECTOR_SCENES[1] without quoting it. Does not state the seal condition, does not name anyone, does not reference the back room or its occupant.

items.title: STRAIN CARRIES OVER
lines: Sleep does not reset Neural Strain. It gives back only a little.
Whatever tonight leaves unspent carries into tomorrow. Spend on a night patch to buy back more before you sleep.
